note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(旅行/在路上主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: On the last day of their road trip, the family reached a quiet beach where no cars were allowed. They left their vehicle by the gate and walked down a narrow path leading to the sea, watching the setting sun paint the sky red. It was a tiring day, but everyone agreed it had been the most beautiful stop of the whole journey.

questions.q: How did the family get down to the sea?
options: They walked along a narrow path on foot.
They drove their vehicle onto the beach.
They took a small boat across the water.
They rode bikes down the steep hill.
questions.explanation: 原文说他们把车停在门口、沿小路步行下海('walked down a narrow path leading to the sea')的转述;车不允许进入。

questions.q: How did the family feel about this stop?
options: They thought it was the finest part of the trip.
They were sorry they had ever come.
They found it dull and wanted to leave.
They were too tired to enjoy anything.
questions.explanation: 末句说大家一致认为这是整段旅程最美的一站(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)。
